plugins.name: swe
plugins.description: An unforgiving senior-engineer standard that fights AI slop: no duplicate functions, one task per unit, one kind per file, tiny leaves, no swallowed errors, hot-path Big-O, plain one-line comments, no templated vibecoded UI. Ships a reviewer agent, a /swe command, and the standard as a skill.
